dijkstra.title: Dijkstra Route Optimizer
dijkstra.description: A desktop application built with C# WinForms that implements Dijkstra's algorithm to calculate the shortest routes and optimize transportation costs between provinces and cities across Southern Vietnam. Features an interactive map visualization, adjacency matrix display, and real-time cost estimation including distance, fuel consumption, and shipping expenses.
dijkstra.result: Enables logistics planners to instantly determine the most cost-effective route between any two Southern Vietnam locations. Reduces manual route planning time by visualizing graph structures and adjacency matrices, providing accurate fuel and cost estimations for optimized freight operations.

coffee.title: Nha Ba Teria POS & Internal System
coffee.description: A POS system and business data dashboard dedicated to coffee shops, tracking revenue and top-selling products.
coffee.result: Streamlines the ordering and checkout process at the counter. Provides visual reports to easily analyze consumer trends, helping owners strategize ingredient stocking and menu adjustments for enhanced business efficiency.

parker.title: Parker The S-Accountant
parker.description: A smart personal finance application that helps users track daily income/expenses and set financial goals.
parker.result: Delivers a clear, comprehensive overview of personal finances. Supports spending habit analysis through visual charts, enabling users to cut unnecessary costs and achieve financial goals 20% faster.
